# Agent-assisted workflow

## Install the agent skills

```bash
iobrpy-cli agent install --client all
```

## Verify the installation

```bash
iobrpy-cli agent status
```

## Start an agent client

Use either client:

```bash
claude
```

```bash
codex
```

## Inspect the project

```text
/iobrpy Please scan /analysis/IOBRpy_PRJNA1161405_demo. Show the full checklist first, then report the current stage and the best next step.
```

## Run the recommended analysis

```text
/iobrpy Run the recommended analysis step and save the outputs to /analysis/IOBRpy_PRJNA1161405_demo/<output_directory>.
```

## Review the results

```text
/iobrpy-result Please audit and summarise /analysis/IOBRpy_PRJNA1161405_demo/<output_directory>. Perform appropriate statistical analyses and compare the Normal and HCC groups. Generate method-aware visualisations in R and provide a basic interpretation of the results.
```
